clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau catches a friend in the act: spring water in the fridge, tap water in the coffee maker.

His point when she asks why it matters: chlorine doesn't care what color the water turns. Soup, tea, a coffee shop latte, even the jarred spaghetti sauce from the store - if it started as tap water, the chlorine rides along.

His own habit: bottled or spring water everywhere, including the ice, since most ice machines run off the same tap line.

What's the last drink you didn't think to check?
